name: TOTP Sign-In Success
summary: A returning user whose durable account has already been identified supplies a valid time-based one-time authenticator code and establishes an authenticated application session through the TOTP continuation path.
finalOutcome: The submitted TOTP proof is accepted for the existing durable identity and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: VerifyTotpAsync provides the reusable TOTP verification primitive.
Canonical authentication view collects the TOTP verification code and permits password fallback.

The success behavior begins at the identified-account TOTP continuation surface. Presentation is coherent; implementation remains in progress because the existing server verify endpoint requires an already confirmed user and the Angular verify handler is still a TODO.
